quiet: Hartley and Osei spent most of that summer digging clay from the river bank.
Nakamura walked along the northern plain and wrote about its rivers.
The department counted salmon in three rivers and found fewer than expected.
Lindqvist and Moreau watched the glacier retreat a little further each spring.
Okafor followed the old trade routes across the Sahel with two camels.
Whitfield learned printing from his uncle in a small shop near the harbour.
The ministry opened rural clinics in villages that had never had a nurse.
Petrov and Klein taught ecology students how to count birds at dawn.
